title: Ramsey number R(5,8), lower bound
statement: Find a two-colouring of the edges of K_n with no red K_5 and no blue K_8; it shows R(5,8) > n. The best known lower bound is R(5,8) >= 101, so a colouring of K_100 is known and one of K_101 or more would improve it.
submission: Text file: the n x n adjacency matrix of the red graph, one line of n characters 0/1 per vertex (1 red, 0 blue), symmetric with a zero diagonal; n <= 2048.
score: n, the number of vertices of the colouring; it proves R(5,8) >= n + 1 (larger is better)

best_known.source: R(5,8) >= 101: [HaKr1] in Small Ramsey Numbers rev. 18 (24 Apr 2026), Table Ia; read 8 Nov 2026

provenance.keeper: Small Ramsey Numbers (S. Radziszowski), EJC Dynamic Survey DS1
